subject: Post-demo MAP: technical evaluation milestones & owner asks
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@healthgrid.com>, Jason Cole <jasonc@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo MAP: technical evaluation milestones & owner asks

Hi Lina / Jason — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap + proposed MAP milestones specifically for the technical evaluation so we can lock responsibilities and dates. Attached: MAP-draft-v1.pdf and benchmark_spec.xlsx (high-level criteria).

Summary of proposed milestones (neutral language so we can move these into the mutual action plan):
1) Environment & credentials: HealthGrid to provide test environment endpoint(s), a service account, and SSO access by 2027-05-19. Owner: Jason (HealthGrid).
2) Data & test corpus freeze: HealthGrid to deliver the representative test query set and any PII-redaction rules by 2027-05-21. Owner: Lina (HealthGrid).
3) Model shortlist & params freeze: Agree on models and quantization profile by 2027-05-26. Owner: Redwood (Ben) + HealthGrid (Lina).
4) Benchmark execution window: Redwood to run full latency/cost/quality runs 2027-05-27 — 2027-06-02. Owner: Redwood (Ben).
5) Technical readout / acceptance decision: Joint readout and acceptance on 2027-06-07. Owner: Joint.

Success criteria (from the spec):
- Quality: task-specific pass rate >= 92% on the validation set (see benchmark_spec.xlsx).
- Latency: p50 <= 150ms, p95 <= 500ms under the target concurrency profile (spec: 8 concurrent agents).
- Cost: inference unit cost <= $0.004 / token (measured across the benchmark workload).

Dependencies we called out: SSO access (Okta SAML), a stable test endpoint with sample traffic, and a representative query set that matches production mix. If any of those slip, the benchmark window will need to shift.

Target commercial milestone: we discussed aiming for a final decision / signature by 2027-06-15 (this is our suggested target close date to align resources).

Next asks:
- Jason: confirm SSO/endpoint owner and whether we need an access request ticket in your tracking system (Jira/ServiceNow) — can you confirm target date for access?
- Lina: confirm the scope of the test corpus (size & redaction needs) and if there are any demo-only traces we should avoid including.
- Ben / Grace: can you confirm Redwood bench owner availability for the week of 5/27 and whether we need a Dedicated pool for the runs or hosted instances will suffice?

Thanks all — I can pull these into the MAP PDF and update once we have confirmations.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (PDF stub), benchmark_spec.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Lina Park <lina@healthgrid.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Jason Cole <jasonc@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: technical evaluation milestones & owner asks

Thanks Jonas — this is very clear and helpful. A few clarifying items from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Latency/cost targets — you listed p50 <= 150ms / p95 <= 500ms and cost <= $0.004/token. Can you confirm whether those numbers are for token-level generation latency measured from request to first-token (or average per-token), and whether cost is counted per generated token or per request (we typically measure per 1k tokens)? We want to ensure apples-to-apples.

2) Model shortlist — you mentioned Redwood will own the shortlist but we want to see both an open-model slate and a quantized variant. Preliminary models we want on the table: Llama3-70B-instruct, Falcon-40B-instruct, and one smaller low-latency quantized model for edge-cases. Can Redwood propose exact model build names we should expect in the benchmark artifact?

3) SSO / access — we can provision Okta SAML, Jason and I will confirm the ServiceNow ticket number once created. We expect to have SSO in place by 2027-05-18 if nothing blocks. 

We are aligned on the overall cadence. Confirming target close date of 2027-06-15 works for us as long as the benchmark window is successful and no major security blockers surface.

-Lina
Lina Park
Head of Platform Engineering, HealthGrid
lina@healthgrid.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: technical evaluation milestones & owner asks

Thanks — I'll take bench lead. Quick operational notes and commitments from Redwood: 

- Redwood ownership: I will own benchmark execution and the primary benchmark artifact (benchmarks/results.csv + run logs). Grace will own ops coordination and escalation if we need Dedicated capacity.
- Model slate we plan to include (final names will be in the MAP artifact):
  * Llama3-70B-instruct (float32 baseline)
  * Falcon-40B-instruct (int8 quantized run)
  * Redwood-lite-13B-quant (high throughput low-cost candidate)
- Measurement clarifications for Lina: latency targets are measured as request-to-first-token (end-to-end) for generation scenarios; per-token averages will be included in the artifact. Cost target will be reported as $ per generated token (we'll also include $ per 1k tokens for your dashboards).
- Infrastructure ask: if HealthGrid can provide an endpoint and at least a lightweight load pattern (curl-based script or k6 sample), we'll run everything on hosted first. If p95 latency is outside target we will re-run on a temporary Dedicated pool (Grace will coordinate quota).

I'm attaching a short run script (benchmark_script_v1.sh) and the initial benchmark_spec.xlsx has the acceptance checks. I'll block the run window on my calendar 2027-05-27 to 2027-06-02 and will publish a run schedule once access is provided.

Action items for Redwood (owned):
- Ben: finalize run harness and smoke-run by 2027-05-24.
- Grace: verify Dedicated availability and pre-reserve if needed by 2027-05-25.

Action items for HealthGrid (owned):
- Jason: SSO & endpoint access by 2027-05-19.
- Lina: test corpus + redaction notes by 2027-05-21.

If those dates hold, we should be able to meet the 2027-06-07 readout and stay on track for the 2027-06-15 commercial decision.

Ben Carter
Bench Lead, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: benchmark_script_v1.sh (script stub)
